title: Fix CI regression from codeql import-hygiene batch

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Investigating failed run 23926590563. Symptom clusters: CLI test/eval commands now returning validation errors; IDE server trace/stream tests returning wrong statuses or missing mock_tools path. Hypothesis: import-hoist refactors in tactus/cli/app.py and tactus/ide/server.py changed monkeypatch-sensitive behavior.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Root cause confirmed and fixed: import-hoisting refactor in tactus/cli/app.py and tactus/ide/server.py changed monkeypatch-sensitive runtime behavior, causing CLI validation-path failures and IDE trace/stream endpoint behavior drift in CI. Applied targeted rollback of those two files to pre-refactor behavior and reran failing suites locally: 195 passed, 0 failed across the previously failing test groups.
